{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[[7]*w for _ in range(h)]
    colors=set(x for row in grid for x in row if x not in (7,8))
    for c in colors:
        ps=[(r,j) for r in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[r][j]==c]
        r0=min(r for r,j in ps); r1=max(r for r,j in ps); j0=min(j for r,j in ps); j1=max(j for r,j in ps)
        hs=[(r,j) for r in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[r][j]==8 and r0-1<=r<=r1+1 and j0-1<=j<=j1+1]
        # marker corner relative to bounding box
        if hs:
            rr,jj=min(hs,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-((r0+r1)/2))+abs(p[1]-((j0+j1)/2)))
            dr=1 if rr>= (r0+r1)/2 else -1
            dc=1 if jj>= (j0+j1)/2 else -1
        else: dr=dc=0
        for r in range(r0+dr,r1+dr+1):
            for j in range(j0+dc,j1+dc+1):
                if 0<=r<h and 0<=j<w: out[r][j]=c
    return out"}

            for k in range(k0+dc,k1+dc+1):
